reproduction_manifest.notes: Successfully reproduced TINN Allen-Cahn Relative L2 Error. 5-seed mean: 3.60e-06 (paper: 3.85e-06 +/- 1.48e-06). All individual runs within paper CI bounds [2.37e-06, 5.33e-06]. Training on A100 GPUs yields ~0.16h per seed vs paper's 0.78h on A6000.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: Parse stdout for 'Metric: Relative L2 Error = <value>' line; extract numeric value in scientific notation
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: Network architecture: t_layers (time encoder), layers (spatial network); Training: epochs, Nc (collocation points), Nic (IC points), lambda_ic (IC penalty weight); LM optimizer: mu_init, div_factor, mul_factor, mu_min, mu_max; Seed affects initialization and collocation sampling
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Base image: pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Install dependencies: pip install 'jax[cuda12]' flax optax scipy matplotlib. JAX 0.6.2 requires jax.tree.map instead of removed jax.tree_map. Reference data new_AC.mat (747KB) is included in repo Allen-Cahn/. Container commit failed due to overlay disk space (200GB limit) - same base image + pip install reproduces environment. Python 3.10, CUDA 12.1, double precision (float64) required.

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize Relative L2 Error on Allen-Cahn benchmark while maintaining training stability. The TINN model solves the 1D Allen-Cahn PDE u_t - 0.0001*u_xx + 5*u^3 - 5*u = 0 with periodic BCs.

metrics.name: Relative L2 Error
metrics.rationale: Primary quality metric measuring how well the learned solution matches the reference solution on Allen-Cahn PDE

metrics.name: Training Time (hours)
metrics.rationale: Training time per seed; A100 hardware ~5x faster than paper A6000. Important but secondary to solution quality

optimization_objective.success_policy: Core metric is Relative L2 Error — improve it as much as possible. Training time should not exceed 1.5x baseline (0.24h per seed) unless the accuracy improvement is substantial (>20% relative). LM optimizer stability must be maintained (no NaN/inf losses).
